source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The current normal multi-day grid uses inline borders for selected-day headers/hour boxes, while the rotated grid uses block borders. Preserve the same selected state while changing geometric axes; blindly replacing physical properties with one logical axis can still be wrong for rotation. RTL and orientation validation remain unrun.
title: Change the selected-day border axis when the calendar rotates
